reason: Single cohesive document model: authored + runtime trees plus the element/animation/effect/transition catalogs (2030 lines, pre-existing). Splitting the catalogs from the tree mapping is a dedicated refactor, not drive-by work.
Desktop project lifecycle in one module: scan, resolve, scaffold, CRUD, compile, manifest/config IO (1255 lines, pre-existing). A lifecycle-vs-IO-vs-compile split is future work.
Single-purpose source-edit applier: ts-morph JSX rewriting behind 3 exports (1252 lines, pre-existing). Large by case coverage, one responsibility.
Chat prompt-input UI component (1108 lines, pre-existing Steroids-era). Decomposition into subcomponents is future work.

Canonical DocumentEditor: single-domain document-mutation vocabulary (props, text, selection, insert, remove, reparent, clipboard) plus source reporting (~30 methods, no cross-domain sprawl). The Human-NLE goal extends it in place deliberately; split the command families if it grows further.
